name: fmp_dividend_calendar
description:
Dividend calendar from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/dividend-calendar): ex-dividend, record and payment dates, dividend amount and yield per company.
Returns {dividends}: FMP's list of dividend events.
Inputs (* required): from_date (YYYY-MM-DD), to_date (YYYY-MM-DD); both optional, FMP's default window applies without them.
Other calendars: fmp_earnings_calendar, fmp_ipo_calendar, fmp_stock_split_calendar, fmp_economic_calendar.
Example: {"from_date": "2025-06-01", "to_date": "2025-06-30"}
